en.tashayyu: 9 – al-Ḥasan b. Asad, al-Ṭafāwī, al-Baṣrī, Abū Muḥammad.

Narrated from weak narrators, and they narrate from him.  His is of a corrupt madhhab.  I do not know anything in which is settled except for his narration of the book of ʿAlī b. Ismāʿīl b. Shuʿayb b. Mītham, and people other than him have narrated it.
